sentences.text: Lab Report: Text classification with neural networks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 16 GB of memory.
The dataset was split into 80 percent training data and the rest for testing.
Figure 1 shows the accuracy of LSTM by dataset.
As shown in Figure 1, on CIFAR-10, LSTM obtains a accuracy of 117.5%.
LSTM reaches 87.5% accuracy on AG News.
LSTM achieves 92.5% accuracy on AG News.
LSTM achieves about 90% accuracy on SVHN.
Figure 2 shows the training loss.
At epoch 50, the loss of MLP is over 0.4 (Figure 2).
MLP has a loss of 0.856 at epoch 40.
As shown in Figure 2, MLP has a loss of 0.536 at epoch 60.
MLP has a loss of 0.429 at epoch 80.
Figure 3 shows the validation accuracy by dataset.
As shown in Figure 3, ResNet-50 achieves 70% validation accuracy on SST-2.
As shown in Figure 3, LSTM outperforms ViT-S by 1.5 percentage points on SVHN.
On SVHN, CNN obtains a validation accuracy of 54.7%.
Figure 4 shows the validation accuracy during training.
At epoch 50, ResNet-18 achieves 83.6% validation accuracy.
From epoch 10 to epoch 20, the validation accuracy of ResNet-18 improves by a relative 7.2%.
ResNet-18 attains a validation accuracy of 80.4% at epoch 20.
As shown in Figure 4, ResNet-18 attains a validation accuracy of over 80% at epoch 40.
Overall, the results are in line with what we expected from the literature.
